options_en.d: Incorrect; adjudicated civil monetary penalties remain, and other applicable laws may also operate.

options_te.d: తప్పు; adjudicated civil monetary penalties కొనసాగుతాయి, ఇతర applicable laws కూడా వర్తించవచ్చు.

explanation_en: Decriminalisation changed the form of BDA sanction; it did not legalise contraventions or extinguish all other liability.
explanation_te: Decriminalisation BDA sanction రూపాన్ని మార్చింది; contraventionsను legal చేయలేదు, ఇతర liabilityను తొలగించలేదు.

question_en: Which description of the 2023 AYUSH-related benefit-sharing carve-out is accurate?
question_te: 2023 AYUSH-related benefit-sharing carve-outను సరిగా వివరించేది ఏది?

options_en.a: It is a narrow exemption tied to cultivated medicinal plants and codified traditional knowledge.
options_en.b: It exempts all wild biological resources used by any AYUSH company.
options_en.c: It abolishes ABS obligations for foreign entities.
options_en.d: It removes the NBA from the BDA.

options_te.a: ఇది cultivated medicinal plants, codified traditional knowledgeకు సంబంధించిన narrow exemption.
options_te.b: ఏ AYUSH company ఉపయోగించినా అన్ని wild biological resourcesను exempt చేస్తుంది.
options_te.c: Foreign entitiesకు ABS obligationsను రద్దు చేస్తుంది.

explanation_en: The carve-out is conditional and narrow. It must not be read as a blanket AYUSH, foreign-entity, or wild-bioprospecting exemption.
explanation_te: ఈ carve-out conditional, narrow. దీన్ని blanket AYUSH, foreign-entity లేదా wild-bioprospecting exemptionగా చదవకూడదు.

question_en: An AYUSH manufacturer commercially collects a wild medicinal plant and claims that every AYUSH use is exempt from benefit sharing. Which conclusion is sound?
question_te: AYUSH manufacturer ఒక wild medicinal plantను commercialగా సేకరించి, ప్రతి AYUSH use benefit sharing నుంచి exempt అంటోంది. సరైన conclusion ఏది?

options_en.a: The claim is valid whenever the firm is Indian.
options_en.b: The claim is overbroad; the statutory carve-out is tied to specified cultivated medicinal plants/codified knowledge, not all wild collection.
options_en.c: The claim is valid if a PBR exists.
options_en.d: The claim is valid because the 2023 amendment abolished ABS.

options_te.b: Claim అతివిస్తృతం; statutory carve-out specified cultivated medicinal plants/codified knowledgeకు సంబంధించినది, అన్ని wild collectionకు కాదు.
options_te.d: 2023 amendment ABSను రద్దు చేసింది కాబట్టి claim చెల్లుతుంది.

explanation_en: Wild commercial bioprospecting does not become exempt merely because the user belongs to the AYUSH sector.
explanation_te: User AYUSH sectorకు చెందినవాడన్న కారణంతో wild commercial bioprospecting exempt కాదు.

question_en: Under amended section 6, what must a section 7 Indian person do for an IP right based on an Indian biological resource?
question_te: Amended section 6 ప్రకారం, Indian biological resource ఆధారిత IP right కోసం section 7 Indian person ఏమి చేయాలి?

options_en.a: Obtain NBA approval before filing and take no later step.
options_en.b: Obtain only SBB approval after grant.
options_en.c: Register with the NBA before grant, then obtain NBA prior approval at commercialisation.
options_en.d: Seek no registration or approval at any stage.

options_te.a: Filingకు ముందు NBA approval తీసుకుని తరువాత ఏ step అవసరం లేదు.
options_te.b: Grant తరువాత SBB approval మాత్రమే తీసుకోవాలి.
options_te.c: Grantకు ముందు NBAతో register చేసి, commercialisation సమయంలో NBA prior approval పొందాలి.
options_te.d: ఏ దశలోనూ registration లేదా approval అవసరం లేదు.

explanation_en: For a section 7 Indian person, section 6(1A) requires registration before grant and section 6(1B) requires prior NBA approval at commercialisation.
explanation_te: Section 7 Indian personకు section 6(1A) ప్రకారం grantకు ముందు registration, section 6(1B) ప్రకారం commercialisation సమయంలో prior NBA approval అవసరం.

question_en: A foreign section 3(2) applicant and an Indian section 7 applicant both seek IP rights based on an Indian biological resource. Which comparison is correct after the 2023 amendment?
question_te: Foreign section 3(2) applicant, Indian section 7 applicant ఇద్దరూ Indian biological resource ఆధారంగా IP rights కోరుతున్నారు. 2023 amendment తరువాత సరైన comparison ఏది?

options_en.a: Both need NBA approval before filing.
options_en.b: Only the Indian applicant needs prior approval before grant.
options_en.c: Neither has any NBA obligation until commercialisation.
options_en.d: The foreign applicant needs NBA prior approval before grant; the Indian applicant registers before grant and needs prior approval at commercialisation.

options_te.a: ఇద్దరికీ filingకు ముందు NBA approval అవసరం.
options_te.b: Indian applicantకు మాత్రమే grantకు ముందు prior approval అవసరం.
options_te.c: Commercialisation వరకు ఎవరికీ NBA obligation లేదు.
options_te.d: Foreign applicantకు grantకు ముందు NBA prior approval; Indian applicant grantకు ముందు registration చేసి commercialisation సమయంలో prior approval పొందాలి.

explanation_en: The trigger moved from filing to grant for all, but the obligation differs: foreign persons need pre-grant approval, while Indian persons register pre-grant and obtain approval at commercialisation.
explanation_te: అందరికీ trigger filing నుంచి grantకు మారింది; obligation మాత్రం వేరు: foreign personsకు pre-grant approval, Indian personsకు pre-grant registrationతో పాటు commercialisationలో approval.

question_en: Why did the 2023 BDA amendment replace the term “by-products” with “derivatives”?
question_te: 2023 BDA amendment “by-products” స్థానంలో “derivatives” పదాన్ని ఎందుకు ఉపయోగించింది?

options_en.a: To expressly cover naturally occurring biochemical compounds derived from a biological resource within the ABS framework.
options_en.b: To exclude every processed biological material from ABS.
options_en.c: To convert biological resources into wildlife under the WPA.
options_en.d: To limit ABS only to agricultural waste.

options_te.a: Biological resource నుంచి ఉత్పన్నమయ్యే naturally occurring biochemical compoundsను ABS frameworkలో స్పష్టంగా చేర్చడానికి.
options_te.b: ప్రతి processed biological materialను ABS నుంచి తొలగించడానికి.
options_te.c: Biological resourcesను WPA కింద wildlifeగా మార్చడానికి.
options_te.d: ABSను agricultural wasteకు మాత్రమే పరిమితం చేయడానికి.

explanation_en: “Derivatives” aligns the definition more closely with the Nagoya framework and expressly captures naturally occurring biochemical compounds derived from biological resources.
explanation_te: “Derivatives” నిర్వచనం Nagoya frameworkకు దగ్గరగా ఉండి biological resources నుంచి వచ్చిన naturally occurring biochemical compoundsను స్పష్టంగా cover చేస్తుంది.

question_en: A naturally occurring biochemical compound is extracted from an Indian biological resource. The user says it falls outside ABS because it is not the raw organism. Which response is strongest?
question_te: Indian biological resource నుంచి naturally occurring biochemical compound extract చేశారు. అది raw organism కాదు కాబట్టి ABS బయట అంటున్నారు. బలమైన response ఏది?

options_en.a: Correct; only whole organisms can trigger ABS.
options_en.b: Incorrect; the amended “derivatives” concept can expressly cover such a compound.
options_en.c: Correct if extraction occurs in India.
options_en.d: Incorrect only when the resource is inside a National Park.

options_te.a: సరైనది; whole organisms మాత్రమే ABSను trigger చేస్తాయి.
options_te.b: తప్పు; amended “derivatives” concept ఇటువంటి compoundను స్పష్టంగా cover చేయగలదు.
options_te.d: Resource National Parkలో ఉంటే మాత్రమే తప్పు.

explanation_en: The derivatives formulation prevents an automatic escape from ABS merely because value is taken as a biochemical compound rather than as the raw organism.
explanation_te: Raw organism బదులు biochemical compound రూపంలో value తీసుకున్నారని మాత్రమే ABS నుంచి automatic escape ఉండదు.

question_en: What is the central policy trade-off debated around the 2023 BDA compliance reforms?
question_te: 2023 BDA compliance reforms చుట్టూ చర్చించే ప్రధాన policy trade-off ఏది?

options_en.a: Forest diversion versus wildlife tourism
options_en.b: Central taxation versus State taxation
options_en.c: Lower research/innovation friction versus concern about weaker direct community participation in ABS terms
options_en.d: National Parks versus Biosphere Reserves

options_te.c: Research/innovation friction తగ్గింపు, ABS termsలో direct community participation బలహీనపడుతుందనే ఆందోళన మధ్య

explanation_en: Supporters emphasise easier research, patenting, and AYUSH activity; critics focus on the shift of more ABS negotiation to the NBA acting for communities.
explanation_te: Supporters సులభమైన research, patenting, AYUSH activityను చెబుతారు; critics communities తరఫున మరింత ABS negotiation NBAకు మారడంపై దృష్టి పెడతారు.

question_en: Patent filings rise after compliance is eased, while local groups report less direct influence over benefit-sharing terms. Which assessment is balanced?
question_te: Compliance సడలించిన తరువాత patent filings పెరిగాయి; benefit-sharing termsపై direct influence తగ్గిందని local groups చెబుతున్నాయి. Balanced assessment ఏది?

options_en.a: The reform is necessarily an unqualified success.
options_en.b: The reform necessarily abolished community rights.
options_en.c: The two observations cannot relate to the same amendment.
options_en.d: They illustrate the intended innovation benefit and the community-participation concern on opposite sides of the same trade-off.

options_te.b: Reform community rightsను తప్పనిసరిగా రద్దు చేసింది.
options_te.c: ఈ రెండు observations ఒకే amendmentకు సంబంధించవు.
options_te.d: ఇవి ఒకే trade-offలో innovation benefit, community-participation concern అనే రెండు వైపులను చూపుతాయి.

explanation_en: The evidence can support both sides of the policy debate; the legal change does not itself resolve which value should carry greater weight.
explanation_te: Evidence policy debateలో రెండు వైపులను support చేయవచ్చు; ఏ valueకు ఎక్కువ weight ఇవ్వాలో legal change ఒక్కటే నిర్ణయించదు.

question_en: Which expenditure is especially associated with the State Biodiversity Fund under the BDA?
question_te: BDA కింద State Biodiversity Fundతో ప్రత్యేకంగా సంబంధం ఉన్న expenditure ఏది?

options_en.a: Managing Biodiversity Heritage Sites and compensating or rehabilitating people economically affected by their notification
options_en.b: Financing only foreign patent litigation
options_en.c: Maintaining every local PBR directly
options_en.d: Paying customs duties on biological imports

options_te.a: Biodiversity Heritage Sites నిర్వహణ, వాటి notification వల్ల ఆర్థికంగా ప్రభావితులైన వారికి compensation లేదా rehabilitation
options_te.b: Foreign patent litigationకు మాత్రమే finance చేయడం

explanation_en: Section 32 notably links the State Fund to BHS management and to compensation or rehabilitation of people economically affected by a BHS notification.
explanation_te: Section 32 State Fundను BHS managementతో పాటు BHS notification వల్ల ఆర్థికంగా ప్రభావితులైన వారి compensation/rehabilitationతో కలుపుతుంది.

question_en: A BMC collects a fee under section 41(3) for access to biological resources in its area. Into which fund can that fee flow, and for what general territorial purpose?
question_te: BMC తన ప్రాంతంలోని biological resources accessకు section 41(3) కింద fee వసూలు చేసింది. అది ఏ fundలోకి వెళ్లి, ఏ territorial purposeకు ఉపయోగపడవచ్చు?

options_en.a: National Biodiversity Fund; any international project
options_en.b: Local Biodiversity Fund; biodiversity conservation and promotion within that local body’s jurisdiction
options_en.c: State Biodiversity Fund; only patent examination
options_en.d: Consolidated Fund of India; wildlife policing only

options_te.a: National Biodiversity Fund; ఏ international projectకైనా
options_te.b: Local Biodiversity Fund; ఆ local body jurisdictionలో biodiversity conservation, promotion
options_te.c: State Biodiversity Fund; patent examinationకు మాత్రమే
options_te.d: Consolidated Fund of India; wildlife policingకు మాత్రమే

explanation_en: BMC collection fees can feed the Local Biodiversity Fund, whose mandate is locally confined. The three Funds provide lawful channels for ABS and related conservation expenditure.
explanation_te: BMC collection fees Local Biodiversity Fundలోకి వెళ్లవచ్చు; దాని mandate local jurisdictionకే పరిమితం. మూడు Funds ABS, related conservation expenditureకు lawful channels ఇస్తాయి.

question_en: Which chronology for the Biological Diversity Rules, 2024 is correct?
question_te: Biological Diversity Rules, 2024కు సరైన chronology ఏది?

options_en.a: Signed and gazetted on 22 October; commenced immediately.
options_en.b: Gazetted on 6 May 2025; commenced on 25 October 2025.
options_en.c: Signed on 22 October 2024, gazetted on 25 October 2024, and commenced on 24 December 2024 after sixty days.
options_en.d: Signed on 25 October 2024 but never commenced.

options_te.c: 22 October 2024న signed, 25 October 2024న gazetted, అరవై రోజుల తరువాత 24 December 2024న commenced.

explanation_en: Rule 1(2) measures sixty days from Official Gazette notification. The Gazette publication date was 25 October 2024, yielding commencement on 24 December 2024; minor amendment rules followed on 6 May 2025. Refresh this current-law detail near the exam.
explanation_te: Rule 1(2) ప్రకారం Official Gazette notification నుంచి అరవై రోజులు లెక్కించాలి. Publication 25 October 2024 కాబట్టి commencement 24 December 2024; minor amendment rules 6 May 2025న వచ్చాయి. Examకు దగ్గరగా ఈ current-law detailను refresh చేయాలి.

question_en: A note treats 22 October 2024 as the Gazette publication date of the Biological Diversity Rules and calculates commencement sixty days from it. What is the error?
question_te: ఒక note Biological Diversity Rules Gazette publication dateను 22 October 2024గా తీసుకుని అక్కడి నుంచి అరవై రోజులు లెక్కించింది. Error ఏది?

options_en.a: It should use the date of the first NBA meeting.
options_en.b: The Rules required no commencement calculation.
options_en.c: It should count from the 2025 minor-amendment date.
options_en.d: It confuses the signing date with the Official Gazette publication date, which was 25 October 2024.

options_te.d: Signing dateను Official Gazette publication dateతో గందరగోళం చేసింది; publication date 25 October 2024.

explanation_en: Where signing and Gazette dates differ, the Gazette publication date governs the rule’s express commencement formula. This recent subordinate-legislation detail remains date-sensitive.
explanation_te: Signing, Gazette dates వేర్వేరైతే, ruleలోని commencement formulaకు Gazette publication dateనే తీసుకోవాలి. ఈ recent subordinate-legislation detail date-sensitive.

question_en: A road project lies within 100 km of an international border. When can the 2023 forest-law border provision potentially apply?
question_te: International border నుంచి 100 km లోపల road project ఉంది. 2023 forest-law border provision ఎప్పుడు వర్తించే అవకాశం ఉంది?

options_en.a: Whenever a State labels the road useful
options_en.b: Whenever the project is privately financed
options_en.c: To every linear project in the 100-km belt
options_en.d: Only when statutory conditions such as a strategic linear project of national importance concerning national security are met

options_te.a: State road useful అని చెప్పిన ప్రతిసారి
options_te.d: National securityకు సంబంధించిన strategic linear project of national importance వంటి statutory conditions నెరవేరినప్పుడు మాత్రమే

explanation_en: Location within 100 km is not enough. The operative statutory category and conditions must be satisfied and current text/rules checked.
explanation_te: 100 km లోపల ఉండటం మాత్రమే సరిపోదు. Operative statutory category, conditions నెరవేరాలి; current text/rulesను పరిశీలించాలి.

question_en: Whose prior approval is central when covered forest land is proposed for non-forest use under the 1980 forest-conservation law?
question_te: 1980 forest-conservation law కింద covered forest landను non-forest useకు ప్రతిపాదించినప్పుడు ఎవరి prior approval ప్రధానంగా అవసరం?

options_en.a: Gram Sabha alone
options_en.b: District Collector
options_en.c: State Pollution Control Board
options_en.d: Central Government

explanation_en: The statute centres prior Central Government approval for specified non-forest use of covered forest land. Other legal clearances may separately apply.
explanation_te: Covered forest land specified non-forest useకు statute Central Government prior approvalను ప్రధానంగా కోరుతుంది. ఇతర legal clearances విడిగా వర్తించవచ్చు.

question_en: Assertion (A): The forest-law 100-km border clause is not a blanket exemption for every project. Reason (R): It is limited by requirements concerning a strategic linear project, national importance, and national security. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): Forest-law 100-km border clause ప్రతి projectకు blanket exemption కాదు. కారణం (R): Strategic linear project, national importance, national security requirementsతో అది పరిమితమైంది. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both are true, and the statutory qualifiers explain why proximity to the border alone is insufficient.
explanation_te: రెండూ నిజం; statutory qualifiers వల్ల border proximity ఒక్కటే ఎందుకు సరిపోదో R వివరిస్తుంది.

question_en: Why can the forest-law border provision have significant ecological consequences?
question_te: Forest-law border provisionకు ముఖ్యమైన ecological consequences ఎందుకు ఉండవచ్చు?

options_en.a: It converts every border forest into a National Park.
options_en.b: It abolishes compensatory afforestation nationwide.
options_en.c: It applies only to treeless urban land.
options_en.d: Strategic linear infrastructure can fragment ecologically sensitive border forests even when its statutory conditions are met.

options_te.a: ప్రతి border forestను National Parkగా మారుస్తుంది.
options_te.d: Statutory conditions నెరవేరినా strategic linear infrastructure ecologically sensitive border forestsను fragment చేయవచ్చు.

explanation_en: Legal eligibility does not remove ecological effects such as fragmentation; project-specific appraisal and safeguards remain important.
explanation_te: Legal eligibility వల్ల fragmentation వంటి ecological effects తొలగవు; project-specific appraisal, safeguards ముఖ్యమే.

question_en: Which obligations are ordinarily imposed on the user agency when forest diversion is approved?
question_te: Forest diversion approve అయినప్పుడు user agencyపై సాధారణంగా విధించే obligations ఏవి?

options_en.a: Wetland notification and Ramsar listing
options_en.b: Only wildlife census costs
options_en.c: Only payment into general tax revenue
options_en.d: Compensatory-afforestation costs and Net Present Value

explanation_en: Approved diversion ordinarily carries compensatory-afforestation and NPV liabilities, subject to the applicable approval and rules.
explanation_te: Approved diversionకు సాధారణంగా compensatory-afforestation, NPV liabilities ఉంటాయి; applicable approval, rulesకు లోబడి ఉంటాయి.

question_en: Which enactment gave the CAMPA framework permanent statutory footing?
question_te: CAMPA frameworkకు permanent statutory footing ఇచ్చిన enactment ఏది?

options_en.a: Forest Rights Act, 2006
options_en.b: Environment (Protection) Act, 1986
options_en.c: Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016
options_en.d: Biological Diversity Act, 2002

explanation_en: The 2016 Act established National and State Funds and authorities for earmarked compensatory-afforestation money.
explanation_te: 2016 Act earmarked compensatory-afforestation money కోసం National, State Funds మరియు authoritiesను ఏర్పాటు చేసింది.

question_en: Which distinction between Individual Forest Rights (IFR) and Community Forest Resource rights (CFR) is correct?
question_te: Individual Forest Rights (IFR), Community Forest Resource rights (CFR) మధ్య సరైన distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: IFR concerns an individual/household holding; CFR empowers the community to protect, regenerate, conserve, manage, and sustainably use its customary forest resource.
options_en.b: IFR belongs only to companies; CFR belongs only to governments.
options_en.c: IFR is a wildlife permit; CFR is a forest-diversion approval.
options_en.d: IFR and CFR are identical labels.

options_te.a: IFR individual/household holdingకు; CFR customary forest resourceను protect, regenerate, conserve, manage, sustainably use చేసే community authorityకు సంబంధించినది.
options_te.b: IFR companiesకు మాత్రమే; CFR governmentsకు మాత్రమే.
options_te.c: IFR wildlife permit; CFR forest-diversion approval.

explanation_en: IFR and CFR protect different rights-holders and interests; CFR is not merely a collection of individual titles.
explanation_te: IFR, CFR వేర్వేరు rights-holders, interestsను రక్షిస్తాయి; CFR కేవలం individual titles సమాహారం కాదు.

question_en: Under the Forest Rights Act, who initiates determination of the nature and extent of forest rights?
question_te: Forest Rights Act కింద forest rights nature, extent determinationను ఎవరు ప్రారంభిస్తారు?

options_en.a: Central Government
options_en.b: Forest Department
options_en.c: District Collector
options_en.d: Gram Sabha

explanation_en: The Gram Sabha initiates the statutory process; higher-level committees examine and decide claims through the prescribed procedure.
explanation_te: Gram Sabha statutory processను ప్రారంభిస్తుంది; prescribed procedureలో higher-level committees claimsను పరిశీలించి నిర్ణయిస్తాయి.

question_en: Which statement best describes the relationship between FRA rights and exclusionary wildlife-conservation measures?
question_te: FRA rights, exclusionary wildlife-conservation measures మధ్య సంబంధాన్ని సరిగా వివరించేది ఏది?

options_en.a: Wildlife law always extinguishes FRA rights automatically.
options_en.b: FRA repealed the Wildlife (Protection) Act.
options_en.c: The two regimes can create real legal and policy tension, especially around Critical Wildlife Habitats, and must be reconciled through their statutory procedures.
options_en.d: They can never apply to the same landscape.

options_te.a: Wildlife law ఎల్లప్పుడూ FRA rightsను automatically extinguish చేస్తుంది.
options_te.c: ప్రత్యేకంగా Critical Wildlife Habitatsలో రెండు regimes మధ్య real legal, policy tension ఉండవచ్చు; statutory procedures ద్వారా reconcile చేయాలి.

explanation_en: The statutes pursue partly different models. Neither automatic harmony nor automatic extinguishment is a sound legal shortcut.
explanation_te: Statutes కొంత భిన్నమైన modelsను అనుసరిస్తాయి. Automatic harmony లేదా automatic extinguishment రెండూ సరైన legal shortcutలు కావు.

question_en: A village seeks collective authority to regenerate and sustainably manage its customary forest tract. Which FRA right is most directly relevant?
question_te: Village తన customary forest tractను collectively regenerate చేసి sustainably manage చేయాలనుకుంటోంది. ఏ FRA right నేరుగా వర్తిస్తుంది?

options_en.a: Individual Forest Right
options_en.b: Compensatory-afforestation right
options_en.c: Wetland-management right
options_en.d: Community Forest Resource right

explanation_en: CFR recognises community authority over protection, regeneration, conservation, management, and sustainable use of the customary forest resource.
explanation_te: CFR customary forest resource protection, regeneration, conservation, management, sustainable useపై community authorityను గుర్తిస్తుంది.

question_en: Under Rule 5 of the Wetlands Rules, 2017, who chairs a State Wetlands Authority?
question_te: Wetlands Rules, 2017 Rule 5 ప్రకారం State Wetlands Authorityకు chair ఎవరు?

options_en.a: Union Environment Secretary
options_en.b: State Chief Secretary
options_en.c: District Collector
options_en.d: State Minister in charge of Environment/Forests or the wetlands department

options_te.d: Environment/Forests లేదా wetlands departmentకు బాధ్యుడైన State Minister

explanation_en: The State Minister is Chairperson and the Chief Secretary is Vice-Chairperson. The parallel UT arrangement is different.
explanation_te: State Minister Chairperson; Chief Secretary Vice-Chairperson. Parallel UT arrangement వేరు.

question_en: Why is the statement “the Chief Secretary chairs every Wetlands Authority” incorrect?
question_te: “Chief Secretary ప్రతి Wetlands Authorityకు chair” అనే statement ఎందుకు తప్పు?

options_en.a: The Chief Secretary has no role anywhere.
options_en.b: Only the Union Government may chair an Authority.
options_en.c: In a State Authority the Chief Secretary is Vice-Chairperson, while a UT Authority may be chaired by the Administrator or Chief Secretary.
options_en.d: Every Authority is chaired by a District Collector.

options_te.b: Union Government మాత్రమే Authorityకు chair కావచ్చు.
options_te.c: State Authorityలో Chief Secretary Vice-Chairperson; UT Authorityకు Administrator లేదా Chief Secretary chair కావచ్చు.

explanation_en: The 2017 Rules distinguish State and UT compositions; they do not prescribe one universal chair.
explanation_te: 2017 Rules State, UT compositionsను వేరు చేస్తాయి; ఒక universal chairను prescribe చేయవు.

question_en: Which change correctly describes the transition from the 2010 to the 2017 wetland rules?
question_te: 2010 నుంచి 2017 wetland rulesకు transitionను సరిగా తెలిపేది ఏది?

options_en.a: State Authorities were abolished in favour of Ramsar Secretariat control.
options_en.b: The NBA replaced all wetland bodies.
options_en.c: The central CWRA model was replaced by decentralised State and UT Wetlands Authorities.
options_en.d: Wetland regulation moved from the EPA to the WPA.

options_te.a: State Authoritiesను రద్దు చేసి Ramsar Secretariat control ఇచ్చారు.
options_te.b: NBA అన్ని wetland bodiesను భర్తీ చేసింది.
options_te.c: Central CWRA model స్థానంలో decentralised State, UT Wetlands Authorities వచ్చాయి.
options_te.d: Wetland regulation EPA నుంచి WPAకు మారింది.

explanation_en: The 2010 Central Wetlands Regulatory Authority was replaced by the decentralised authority structure under the 2017 Rules.
explanation_te: 2010 Central Wetlands Regulatory Authority స్థానంలో 2017 Rules కింద decentralised authority structure వచ్చింది.

question_en: Which set is correctly matched under the wetland frameworks?
question_te: Wetland frameworks కింద సరిగా matched అయిన set ఏది?

options_en.a: State Authority Chair—State Minister; State Vice-Chair—Chief Secretary; UT Chair—Administrator/Chief Secretary; 2010 central body—CWRA
options_en.b: State Chair—District Collector; State Vice-Chair—Governor; UT Chair—NBA; 2010 body—NBWL
options_en.c: State Chair—Chief Secretary only; UT Chair—State Minister; 2010 body—NPCA
options_en.d: State Chair—Ramsar Secretary; UT Chair—MoEFCC Minister; 2010 body—SBB

options_te.a: State Authority Chair—State Minister; State Vice-Chair—Chief Secretary; UT Chair—Administrator/Chief Secretary; 2010 central body—CWRA
options_te.b: State Chair—District Collector; State Vice-Chair—Governor; UT Chair—NBA; 2010 body—NBWL
options_te.c: State Chair—Chief Secretary మాత్రమే; UT Chair—State Minister; 2010 body—NPCA
options_te.d: State Chair—Ramsar Secretary; UT Chair—MoEFCC Minister; 2010 body—SBB

explanation_en: Only option A reproduces the distinct State, UT, and former 2010 central arrangements.
explanation_te: Option A మాత్రమే State, UT, former 2010 central arrangementsను సరిగా చూపుతుంది.

question_en: A wetland is internationally listed under Ramsar but has not undergone the relevant domestic regulatory process. Can these statuses differ?
question_te: Wetland Ramsar కింద internationally listed అయింది; relevant domestic regulatory process జరగలేదు. ఈ statuses వేర్వేరుగా ఉండవచ్చా?

options_en.a: No; Ramsar listing automatically completes every Indian notification.
options_en.b: Yes; Ramsar designation and regulation under the Wetlands Rules are separate legal processes.
options_en.c: No; the Wetlands Rules prohibit Ramsar listing.
options_en.d: Yes, because Ramsar listing repeals domestic law.

options_te.a: కాదు; Ramsar listing ప్రతి Indian notificationను automatically పూర్తి చేస్తుంది.
options_te.b: అవును; Ramsar designation, Wetlands Rules కింద regulation వేర్వేరు legal processes.
options_te.c: కాదు; Wetlands Rules Ramsar listingను prohibit చేస్తాయి.
options_te.d: అవును; Ramsar listing domestic lawను repeal చేస్తుంది.

explanation_en: A wetland may have Ramsar status, domestic regulatory status, both, or neither. One does not automatically create the other.
explanation_te: Wetlandకు Ramsar status, domestic regulatory status, రెండూ లేదా ఏదీ లేకపోవచ్చు. ఒకటి మరొకదాన్ని automatically సృష్టించదు.

question_en: Ramsar Site status primarily arises under which instrument?
question_te: Ramsar Site status ప్రధానంగా ఏ instrument కింద వస్తుంది?

options_en.a: Ramsar Convention on Wetlands
options_en.b: Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972
options_en.c: Forest Rights Act, 2006
options_en.d: Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016

explanation_en: Ramsar status is an international designation under the Convention; enforceable domestic controls arise separately under applicable Indian law.
explanation_te: Ramsar status Convention కింద international designation; enforceable domestic controls వర్తించే Indian law కింద విడిగా వస్తాయి.

question_en: Which statement correctly distinguishes NPCA from the Wetlands Rules, 2017?
question_te: NPCAను Wetlands Rules, 2017 నుంచి సరిగా వేరు చేసే statement ఏది?

options_en.a: Both are protected-area categories under the WPA.
options_en.b: NPCA is a non-statutory funding/implementation scheme; the Wetlands Rules are EPA-based subordinate legislation imposing regulatory controls.
options_en.c: NPCA is an international treaty; the Rules are voluntary guidelines.
options_en.d: The Rules fund projects, while NPCA creates criminal offences.

options_te.b: NPCA non-statutory funding/implementation scheme; Wetlands Rules EPA-based subordinate legislationగా regulatory controls విధిస్తాయి.
options_te.c: NPCA international treaty; Rules voluntary guidelines.
options_te.d: Rules projectsకు funding ఇస్తాయి; NPCA criminal offences సృష్టిస్తుంది.

explanation_en: NPCA finances approved management interventions; the Rules supply the regulatory framework and authorities.
explanation_te: NPCA approved management interventionsకు finance చేస్తుంది; Rules regulatory framework, authoritiesను అందిస్తాయి.

question_en: NPCA was created in February 2013 by merging which two programmes?
question_te: NPCA February 2013లో ఏ రెండు programmesను merge చేసి సృష్టించారు?

options_en.a: National Wetland Conservation Programme and National Lake Conservation Plan
options_en.b: Project Tiger and Project Elephant
options_en.c: CAMPA and Green India Mission
options_en.d: Ramsar Convention and Wetlands Rules

options_te.a: National Wetland Conservation Programme, National Lake Conservation Plan

explanation_en: NPCA combined the NWCP (1986) and NLCP (2001).
explanation_te: NPCA, NWCP (1986), NLCP (2001)లను కలిపింది.

question_en: Under the dated 2024 NPCA Guidelines, which Centre:State funding pattern is correct?
question_te: Dated 2024 NPCA Guidelines ప్రకారం సరైన Centre:State funding pattern ఏది?

options_en.a: 50:50 for all States and UTs
options_en.b: 60:40 for most States, 90:10 for North-Eastern/Himalayan States, and 100% Central funding for UTs
options_en.c: 90:10 for every State and 60:40 for UTs
options_en.d: 100% Central funding for every State

options_te.b: Most Statesకు 60:40, North-Eastern/Himalayan Statesకు 90:10, UTsకు 100% Central funding

explanation_en: These are the dated 2024 guideline ratios; administrative funding patterns must be rechecked against the guidelines current on the exam date.
explanation_te: ఇవి dated 2024 guideline ratios; exam date నాటికి current guidelinesతో administrative funding patternsను మళ్లీ verify చేయాలి.

question_en: Why should an answer quoting NPCA funding ratios state the guideline date?
question_te: NPCA funding ratiosను చెప్పే answer guideline dateను ఎందుకు పేర్కొనాలి?

options_en.a: Because the Constitution fixes a new ratio daily.
options_en.b: Because NPCA is an administrative scheme whose cost-sharing terms can change through revised guidelines.
options_en.c: Because Ramsar Secretariat sets Indian budget ratios.
options_en.d: Because Wetlands Rules prohibit stable ratios.

options_te.a: Constitution రోజూ కొత్త ratioను fix చేస్తుంది కాబట్టి.
options_te.b: NPCA administrative scheme; revised guidelines ద్వారా cost-sharing terms మారవచ్చు కాబట్టి.
options_te.c: Ramsar Secretariat Indian budget ratiosను నిర్ణయిస్తుంది కాబట్టి.
options_te.d: Wetlands Rules stable ratiosను prohibit చేస్తాయి కాబట్టి.

explanation_en: Unlike the stable distinction between scheme and statute, cost-sharing ratios are administrative and date-sensitive.
explanation_te: Scheme, statute మధ్య stable distinctionకు భిన్నంగా cost-sharing ratios administrative, date-sensitive.

question_en: Which combination can legally coexist for the same wetland?
question_te: ఒకే wetlandకు ఏ combination legally coexist కావచ్చు?

options_en.a: Ramsar listing, domestic regulation under the Wetlands Rules, and NPCA project funding
options_en.b: Only Ramsar listing; all Indian measures are excluded
options_en.c: Only NPCA funding; legal regulation is impossible
options_en.d: A Wetlands Rules notification only if Ramsar status is surrendered

options_te.a: Ramsar listing, Wetlands Rules కింద domestic regulation, NPCA project funding
options_te.b: Ramsar listing మాత్రమే; అన్ని Indian measures excluded
options_te.c: NPCA funding మాత్రమే; legal regulation అసాధ్యం
options_te.d: Ramsar status surrender చేస్తేనే Wetlands Rules notification

explanation_en: International designation, domestic regulation, and scheme funding are separate layers and may overlap on one site.
explanation_te: International designation, domestic regulation, scheme funding వేర్వేరు layers; ఒకే siteపై overlap కావచ్చు.

question_en: Which distinction between Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ) and Eco-Sensitive Zone (ESZ) is correct?
question_te: Coastal Regulation Zone (CRZ), Eco-Sensitive Zone (ESZ) మధ్య సరైన distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: CRZ categorises coastal stretches and waters; an ESZ is a site-specific regulated buffer around a protected area.
options_en.b: CRZ exists only around National Parks; ESZ covers every coastline.
options_en.c: CRZ is under the FRA; ESZ is under the BDA.
options_en.d: They are two names for the same notification.

options_te.a: CRZ coastal stretches, watersను categorise చేస్తుంది; ESZ protected area చుట్టూ site-specific regulated buffer.
options_te.b: CRZ National Parks చుట్టూ మాత్రమే; ESZ ప్రతి coastlineను cover చేస్తుంది.
options_te.c: CRZ FRA కింద; ESZ BDA కింద.

explanation_en: Both use EPA powers, but their spatial subjects and operative notifications differ.
explanation_te: రెండూ EPA powersను ఉపయోగించినా వాటి spatial subjects, operative notifications వేరు.

question_en: Assertion (A): CRZ and ESZ are the same legal instrument because both trace to the EPA. Reason (R): CRZ addresses coastal zones, while an ESZ is notified around a protected area. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): CRZ, ESZ రెండూ EPA ఆధారంగా ఉన్నందున ఒకే legal instrument. కారణం (R): CRZ coastal zonesను; ESZ protected area చుట్టూ ప్రాంతాన్ని address చేస్తుంది. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is false, but R is true.
options_en.d: A is true, but R is false.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Shared parent statute does not collapse distinct notifications into one instrument. A is false and R is true.
explanation_te: Common parent statute ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన distinct notifications ఒకే instrument కావు. A తప్పు; R నిజం.

question_en: Under CRZ Notification, 2019, which category covers the inter-tidal zone between the High Tide Line and Low Tide Line?
question_te: CRZ Notification, 2019 ప్రకారం High Tide Line, Low Tide Line మధ్య inter-tidal zone ఏ categoryలో ఉంటుంది?

options_en.a: CRZ-I B
options_en.b: CRZ-II
options_en.c: CRZ-III B
options_en.d: CRZ-IV B

explanation_en: CRZ-I B covers the inter-tidal zone; CRZ-I A covers specified ecologically sensitive areas.
explanation_te: CRZ-I B inter-tidal zoneను cover చేస్తుంది; CRZ-I A specified ecologically sensitive areasను cover చేస్తుంది.

question_en: Which matching of CRZ categories is correct under the 2019 notification?
question_te: 2019 notification కింద సరైన CRZ category matching ఏది?

options_en.a: CRZ-II—rural coast; CRZ-III—urban coast; CRZ-IV—upland forests
options_en.b: CRZ-II—coastal waters; CRZ-III—inter-tidal zone; CRZ-IV—urban coast
options_en.c: CRZ-II—developed urban coast; CRZ-III—rural/relatively undisturbed coast; CRZ-IV—coastal and tidal-influenced waters
options_en.d: CRZ-II—mangroves only; CRZ-III—ports only; CRZ-IV—National Parks

options_te.a: CRZ-II—rural coast; CRZ-III—urban coast; CRZ-IV—upland forests
options_te.b: CRZ-II—coastal waters; CRZ-III—inter-tidal zone; CRZ-IV—urban coast
options_te.c: CRZ-II—developed urban coast; CRZ-III—rural/relatively undisturbed coast; CRZ-IV—coastal, tidal-influenced waters
options_te.d: CRZ-II—mangroves మాత్రమే; CRZ-III—ports మాత్రమే; CRZ-IV—National Parks

explanation_en: The 2019 notification distinguishes developed land, relatively undisturbed/rural land, and water areas through CRZ-II, III, and IV respectively.
explanation_te: 2019 notification developed land, relatively undisturbed/rural land, water areasను వరుసగా CRZ-II, III, IVగా వేరు చేస్తుంది.

question_en: Under the stated CRZ Notification, 2019 framework, how does the No Development Zone differ within CRZ-III?
question_te: Stated CRZ Notification, 2019 framework ప్రకారం CRZ-IIIలో No Development Zone ఎలా వేరు అవుతుంది?

options_en.a: Both III-A and III-B invariably have a 500-m NDZ.
options_en.b: III-A has 200 m and III-B has 50 m.
options_en.c: Densely populated III-A has 50 m; III-B has 200 m.
options_en.d: Neither subcategory has an NDZ.

options_te.c: Densely populated III-Aకు 50 m; III-Bకు 200 m.

explanation_en: The stated 2019 notification uses 50 m for densely populated CRZ-III A and 200 m for CRZ-III B. Always check the operative notification and amendments on the relevant date.
explanation_te: Stated 2019 notification densely populated CRZ-III Aకు 50 m, CRZ-III Bకు 200 mను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. Relevant dateకు operative notification, amendmentsను verify చేయాలి.

question_en: A mangrove patch measures 1,200 square metres. Under the stated CRZ Notification, 2019 rule, what follows?
question_te: Mangrove patch 1,200 square metres ఉంది. Stated CRZ Notification, 2019 rule ప్రకారం ఏమవుతుంది?

options_en.a: It is automatically outside CRZ because it is below one hectare.
options_en.b: It falls in CRZ-I A and attracts the specified 50-m buffer, also treated as CRZ-I A.
options_en.c: It becomes CRZ-II with no buffer.
options_en.d: It becomes an ESZ of exactly 10 km.

options_te.a: One hectareకన్నా తక్కువ కాబట్టి automatically CRZ బయట ఉంటుంది.
options_te.b: ఇది CRZ-I Aలోకి వచ్చి specified 50-m bufferను పొందుతుంది; buffer కూడా CRZ-I Aగా treat అవుతుంది.

explanation_en: Because the patch exceeds the notification’s 1,000 sq m threshold, the specified treatment applies. The threshold and buffer must not be generalised beyond the operative notification.
explanation_te: Patch notificationలోని 1,000 sq m thresholdను మించినందున specified treatment వర్తిస్తుంది. Operative notificationకు మించి threshold, bufferను generalise చేయకూడదు.

question_en: Which of the following has a statutory basis rather than being merely an executive scheme?
question_te: కింది వాటిలో merely executive scheme కాకుండా statutory basis ఉన్నది ఏది?

options_en.a: NPCA
options_en.b: CAMPA under the Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016
options_en.c: National Lake Conservation Plan
options_en.d: National Wetland Conservation Programme

options_te.b: Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016 కింద CAMPA

explanation_en: CAMPA has statutory footing under the 2016 Act; NPCA and its predecessor programmes are executive schemes.
explanation_te: CAMPAకు 2016 Act కింద statutory footing ఉంది; NPCA, predecessor programmes executive schemes.

question_en: A petition alleges only violation of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972. Why is direct National Green Tribunal jurisdiction not automatic?
question_te: Petition Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 violationను మాత్రమే alleges చేస్తోంది. Direct National Green Tribunal jurisdiction ఎందుకు automatic కాదు?

options_en.a: The NGT can hear only tax disputes.
options_en.b: The WPA is not listed in Schedule I of the NGT Act; an overlapping issue under a scheduled enactment is ordinarily needed.
options_en.c: Wildlife disputes belong exclusively to the Ramsar Secretariat.
options_en.d: The NGT Act expressly repealed the WPA.

options_te.b: WPA, NGT Act Schedule Iలో listed కాదు; సాధారణంగా scheduled enactment కింద overlapping issue అవసరం.
options_te.c: Wildlife disputes Ramsar Secretariatకు మాత్రమే చెందుతాయి.
options_te.d: NGT Act WPAను expressly repeal చేసింది.

explanation_en: NGT jurisdiction is tied to the Schedule I enactments. A wildlife dispute may reach the NGT through a genuine overlapping scheduled-law issue, but WPA violation alone does not automatically establish jurisdiction.
explanation_te: NGT jurisdiction Schedule I enactmentsకు కట్టుబడి ఉంటుంది. Genuine overlapping scheduled-law issue ద్వారా wildlife dispute NGTకు రావచ్చు; WPA violation ఒక్కటే jurisdictionను automatically establish చేయదు.

question_en: What is the safest first step when classifying a named biodiversity institution in an examination question?
question_te: Exam questionలో named biodiversity institutionను classify చేయడానికి safest first step ఏది?

options_en.a: Identify its constituting law or executive basis before inferring its powers.
options_en.b: Assume every body under MoEFCC is statutory.
options_en.c: Treat every authority as a funding scheme.
options_en.d: Classify it only by the city where it is located.

options_te.a: దాని powersను ఊహించే ముందు constituting law లేదా executive basisను గుర్తించడం.
options_te.b: MoEFCC కింద ప్రతి body statutory అని భావించడం.
options_te.d: అది ఉన్న city ఆధారంగా మాత్రమే classify చేయడం.

explanation_en: Institutions with similar conservation purposes may be statutory bodies, ministries, autonomous institutes, or schemes. Their legal source controls the classification.
explanation_te: ఒకే తరహా conservation purposes ఉన్న institutions statutory bodies, ministries, autonomous institutes లేదా schemes కావచ్చు. Classificationను వాటి legal source నిర్ణయిస్తుంది.

question_en: Assertion (A): India’s biodiversity governance includes institutions outside the BDA’s NBA–SBB–BMC structure. Reason (R): Bodies such as NBWL, NTCA, WCCB, CZA, and WII arise from wildlife law or executive arrangements. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): భారత biodiversity governanceలో BDAలోని NBA–SBB–BMC structureకు బయట institutions కూడా ఉన్నాయి. కారణం (R): NBWL, NTCA, WCCB, CZA, WII వంటి bodies wildlife law లేదా executive arrangements నుంచి ఏర్పడ్డాయి. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.

explanation_en: Both are true, and the existence of wildlife-law and executive institutions explains why the governance map extends beyond the BDA pyramid.
explanation_te: రెండూ నిజం; wildlife-law, executive institutions ఉండటం వల్ల governance map BDA pyramidకు మించి ఎందుకు విస్తరిస్తుందో R వివరిస్తుంది.

question_en: Which description of the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change is legally accurate?
question_te: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Changeను చట్టపరంగా సరిగా వివరించేది ఏది?

options_en.a: A statutory authority created by BDA section 8
options_en.b: A statutory wildlife board under WPA section 5A
options_en.c: A Union ministry organised under the Allocation of Business Rules, not a body constituted by a specific environmental statute
options_en.d: A non-government research society

options_te.b: WPA section 5A కింద statutory wildlife board
options_te.c: Allocation of Business Rules కింద organised Union ministry; specific environmental statute సృష్టించిన body కాదు

explanation_en: MoEFCC is the nodal Union ministry for environment, forests, and wildlife. A ministry’s executive/legal organisation is distinct from a statutory authority created by an Act.
explanation_te: MoEFCC environment, forests, wildlifeకు nodal Union ministry. Ministry executive/legal organisation, Act సృష్టించిన statutory authorityకు వేరు.

question_en: Which role most appropriately belongs to MoEFCC rather than a specialised statutory body?
question_te: Specialised statutory bodyకన్నా MoEFCCకు సరిపోయే role ఏది?

options_en.a: Recognition of individual zoos under section 38H
options_en.b: Investigation of organised wildlife trafficking as WCCB
options_en.c: Approval of tiger conservation plans as NTCA
options_en.d: Overall Union policy coordination for environment, forests, and wildlife

options_te.d: Environment, forests, wildlifeపై overall Union policy coordination

explanation_en: MoEFCC supplies ministry-wide policy and administrative coordination; specialised statutory functions belong to the bodies created for them.
explanation_te: MoEFCC ministry-wide policy, administrative coordination ఇస్తుంది; specialised statutory functions వాటి కోసం సృష్టించిన bodiesకు చెందుతాయి.

question_en: Which BDA institution is a body corporate established by the Central Government under section 8?
question_te: BDA section 8 కింద Central Government ఏర్పాటు చేసే body corporate ఏది?

options_en.a: National Biodiversity Authority
options_en.b: State Biodiversity Board
options_en.c: Biodiversity Management Committee
options_en.d: National Board for Wildlife

explanation_en: Section 8 provides for the NBA. SBBs arise under section 22 and BMCs under section 41.
explanation_te: Section 8 NBAకు ఆధారం. SBBలకు section 22, BMCలకు section 41 ఆధారం.

question_en: Which allocation of the BDA’s three institutional tiers is correct?
question_te: BDAలోని మూడు institutional tiersకు సరైన allocation ఏది?

options_en.a: NBA—local; SBB—national; BMC—State
options_en.b: NBA—national; SBB—State; BMC—local body
options_en.c: NBA—State; SBB—local; BMC—national
options_en.d: All three—national only

explanation_en: The BDA uses a national NBA, State-level SBBs, and local-body BMCs. Coordination among tiers does not make BMCs subordinate branch offices of SBBs.
explanation_te: BDA national NBA, State-level SBBs, local-body BMCలను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. Tiers మధ్య coordination వల్ల BMCలు SBB subordinate branch offices కావు.

question_en: Which statement about the National Board for Wildlife is correct?
question_te: National Board for Wildlife గురించి సరైన statement ఏది?

options_en.a: It is a non-statutory research institute chaired by the WII Director.
options_en.b: It is a BDA body chaired by the Environment Secretary.
options_en.c: It is a statutory WPA body chaired by the Prime Minister, with a Standing Committee handling much project scrutiny.
options_en.d: It is an executive wetland-funding scheme.

options_te.a: ఇది WII Director chair చేసే non-statutory research institute.
options_te.b: ఇది Environment Secretary chair చేసే BDA body.
options_te.c: ఇది Prime Minister chair చేసే statutory WPA body; Standing Committee చాలా project scrutinyను నిర్వహిస్తుంది.

explanation_en: NBWL is statutory under WPA section 5A. Its Standing Committee is central to scrutiny of many proposals affecting protected areas and wildlife habitats.
explanation_te: NBWLకు WPA section 5A statutory basis. Protected areas, wildlife habitatsను ప్రభావితం చేసే అనేక proposals scrutinyలో Standing Committee కీలకం.

question_en: Assertion (A): The NBWL Standing Committee often scrutinises individual project proposals affecting protected areas. Reason (R): NTCA is the statutory specialist body for tiger-reserve governance under WPA section 38L. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): Protected areasను ప్రభావితం చేసే individual project proposalsను NBWL Standing Committee తరచుగా scrutinise చేస్తుంది. కారణం (R): WPA section 38L కింద tiger-reserve governanceకు NTCA statutory specialist body. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both statements are true, but NTCA’s tiger-specific role does not explain the NBWL Standing Committee’s broader project-scrutiny role.
explanation_te: రెండు statements నిజం; కానీ NTCA tiger-specific role, NBWL Standing Committee broader project-scrutiny roleను వివరించదు.

question_en: Which institution has a statutory mandate focused on tiger-reserve governance?
question_te: Tiger-reserve governanceపై statutory mandate ఉన్న institution ఏది?

options_en.a: National Tiger Conservation Authority
options_en.b: Wildlife Institute of India
options_en.c: Central Zoo Authority
options_en.d: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau

explanation_en: NTCA is the WPA section 38L authority for tiger conservation and tiger-reserve governance.
explanation_te: NTCA, tiger conservation, tiger-reserve governance కోసం WPA section 38L authority.

question_en: Which distinction between NTCA and WII is correct?
question_te: NTCA, WII మధ్య సరైన distinction ఏది?

options_en.a: Both are non-statutory training institutes.
options_en.b: NTCA is a statutory regulator/authority under the WPA; WII is an autonomous research and training institute under MoEFCC.
options_en.c: WII regulates tiger-reserve boundaries while NTCA runs zoos.
options_en.d: NTCA is a funding scheme and WII is a court.

options_te.b: NTCA WPA కింద statutory regulator/authority; WII MoEFCC కింద autonomous research, training institute.
options_te.c: WII tiger-reserve boundariesను regulate చేస్తుంది; NTCA zoos నడుపుతుంది.

explanation_en: NTCA exercises statutory tiger-governance functions. WII supplies scientific research, monitoring methods, training, and technical support.
explanation_te: NTCA statutory tiger-governance functions నిర్వహిస్తుంది. WII scientific research, monitoring methods, training, technical support ఇస్తుంది.

question_en: Which body is specifically constituted to combat organised wildlife crime and illegal wildlife trade?
question_te: Organised wildlife crime, illegal wildlife tradeను ఎదుర్కొనేందుకు ప్రత్యేకంగా constituted body ఏది?

options_en.a: National Biodiversity Authority
options_en.b: National Board for Wildlife
options_en.c: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau
options_en.d: Wildlife Institute of India

explanation_en: WCCB is the specialised statutory wildlife-crime body under the WPA.
explanation_te: WCCB, WPA కింద specialised statutory wildlife-crime body.

question_en: Which statutory citation correctly identifies the Wildlife Crime Control Bureau?
question_te: Wildlife Crime Control Bureauను సరిగా గుర్తించే statutory citation ఏది?

options_en.a: BDA section 8
options_en.b: WPA section 38A
options_en.c: WPA section 38L
options_en.d: WPA section 38Y

explanation_en: WCCB is constituted under WPA section 38Y. Section 38XA is a separate savings provision and should not be confused with its constituting section.
explanation_te: WCCBకు WPA section 38Y ఆధారం. Section 38XA వేరే savings provision; constituting sectionతో గందరగోళం చేయకూడదు.

question_en: What is the principal statutory function of the Central Zoo Authority?
question_te: Central Zoo Authority ప్రధాన statutory function ఏది?

options_en.a: Recognising and regulating zoos, including oversight of conservation breeding
options_en.b: Investigating every wildlife offence
options_en.c: Notifying Tiger Reserves
options_en.d: Maintaining village PBRs

options_te.a: Zoosను recognise, regulate చేయడం; conservation breeding oversightతో సహా

explanation_en: CZA regulates zoo recognition and standards and supports ex-situ conservation and conservation-breeding responsibilities.
explanation_te: CZA zoo recognition, standardsను regulate చేసి ex-situ conservation, conservation-breeding responsibilitiesకు support ఇస్తుంది.

question_en: Assertion (A): CZA is a statutory body under WPA section 38A. Reason (R): WII is an autonomous, non-statutory institute under MoEFCC. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): CZA, WPA section 38A కింద statutory body. కారణం (R): WII, MoEFCC కింద autonomous, non-statutory institute. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both are true, but WII’s executive/autonomous character does not explain CZA’s separate statutory foundation.
explanation_te: రెండూ నిజం; కానీ WII executive/autonomous character, CZA separate statutory foundationను వివరించదు.

question_en: Which statement correctly describes the Wildlife Institute of India?
question_te: Wildlife Institute of Indiaను సరిగా వివరించే statement ఏది?

options_en.a: It is the statutory zoo regulator under section 38A.
options_en.b: It is the statutory wildlife-crime bureau under section 38Y.
options_en.c: It is an autonomous MoEFCC institute for wildlife research and training, not a body constituted by a section of an Act.
options_en.d: It is the Prime Minister-chaired wildlife board.

options_te.a: ఇది section 38A కింద statutory zoo regulator.
options_te.b: ఇది section 38Y కింద statutory wildlife-crime bureau.
options_te.c: ఇది wildlife research, training కోసం MoEFCC కింద autonomous institute; Act section సృష్టించిన body కాదు.
options_te.d: ఇది Prime Minister chair చేసే wildlife board.

explanation_en: WII, Dehradun, is a scientific and training institute established administratively; it is not NBWL, NTCA, CZA, or WCCB.
explanation_te: WII, Dehradun administratively established scientific, training institute; ఇది NBWL, NTCA, CZA లేదా WCCB కాదు.

question_en: Which task is most characteristically performed by the Wildlife Institute of India?
question_te: Wildlife Institute of Indiaకు అత్యంత characteristic task ఏది?

options_en.a: Recognition of zoos
options_en.b: Adjudication of environmental disputes
options_en.c: Collection of compensatory-afforestation money
options_en.d: Wildlife research, population-monitoring methodology, management training, and technical support

options_te.d: Wildlife research, population-monitoring methodology, management training, technical support

explanation_en: WII is the national wildlife research and training institute; it does not exercise the statutory regulatory powers of CZA, NGT, or CAMPA.
explanation_te: WII national wildlife research, training institute; CZA, NGT, CAMPA statutory regulatory powersను exercise చేయదు.

question_en: Which pairing of national survey institutions is correct?
question_te: National survey institutionsకు సరైన pairing ఏది?

options_en.a: BSI—plants; ZSI—animals
options_en.b: BSI—animals; ZSI—plants
options_en.c: BSI—forest-cover mapping; ZSI—wetland funding
options_en.d: BSI—plant patents; ZSI—zoo recognition

explanation_en: BSI inventories and studies plant diversity, while ZSI performs the corresponding national taxonomic work for animal diversity.
explanation_te: BSI plant diversityను inventory, study చేస్తుంది; ZSI animal diversityపై corresponding national taxonomic work చేస్తుంది.

question_en: What is the legal-administrative character of BSI and ZSI?
question_te: BSI, ZSI legal-administrative character ఏది?

options_en.a: Statutory authorities under the BDA
options_en.b: Non-statutory subordinate offices of MoEFCC
options_en.c: Constitutional commissions
options_en.d: Private conservation trusts

explanation_en: Their national scientific role does not make them statutory regulators; both operate as subordinate offices of MoEFCC.
explanation_te: వాటి national scientific role వల్ల statutory regulators కావు; రెండూ MoEFCC subordinate officesగా పనిచేస్తాయి.

question_en: Which institution publishes the India State of Forest Report and conducts remote-sensing-based forest-cover assessment?
question_te: India State of Forest Reportను publish చేసి remote-sensing-based forest-cover assessment చేసే institution ఏది?

options_en.a: Botanical Survey of India
options_en.b: Wildlife Institute of India
options_en.c: Forest Survey of India
options_en.d: National Biodiversity Authority

explanation_en: FSI assesses forest and tree resources and publishes the biennial ISFR.
explanation_te: FSI forest, tree resourcesను assess చేసి biennial ISFRను publish చేస్తుంది.

question_en: Assertion (A): FSI is a non-statutory subordinate office of MoEFCC. Reason (R): NBPGR conserves plant germplasm in the National Genebank. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): FSI, MoEFCC కింద non-statutory subordinate office. కారణం (R): NBPGR National Genebankలో plant germplasmను conserve చేస్తుంది. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both statements are true but concern separate institutions and functions; NBPGR’s genebank role does not explain FSI’s administrative status.
explanation_te: రెండు statements నిజం; కానీ వేర్వేరు institutions, functionsకు చెందినవి. NBPGR genebank role, FSI administrative statusను వివరించదు.

question_en: Which institution is India’s nodal agency for plant genetic resources and operates the National Genebank?
question_te: Plant genetic resourcesకు India nodal agencyగా National Genebankను నిర్వహించే institution ఏది?

options_en.a: ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources
options_en.b: Forest Survey of India
options_en.c: Zoological Survey of India
options_en.d: Central Zoo Authority

options_te.a: ICAR–National Bureau of Plant Genetic Resources

explanation_en: NBPGR explores, collects, characterises, evaluates, quarantines, and conserves plant germplasm.
explanation_te: NBPGR plant germplasmను explore, collect, characterise, evaluate, quarantine, conserve చేస్తుంది.

question_en: Which activity falls within NBPGR’s mandate?
question_te: NBPGR mandateలోకి వచ్చే activity ఏది?

options_en.a: Approving mining inside a sanctuary
options_en.b: Plant-quarantine clearance for imported or exported germplasm
options_en.c: Adjudicating ABS disputes
options_en.d: Recognising zoological parks

options_te.b: Imported లేదా exported germplasmకు plant-quarantine clearance

explanation_en: Plant-quarantine work for germplasm and ex-situ conservation in the National Genebank are core NBPGR functions.
explanation_te: Germplasm plant-quarantine work, National Genebankలో ex-situ conservation NBPGR core functions.

question_en: Which institution specialises in ornithology, bird-habitat research, and training?
question_te: Ornithology, bird-habitat research, trainingలో specialise చేసే institution ఏది?

options_en.a: FSI
options_en.b: NBPGR
options_en.c: Sálim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History
options_en.d: WCCB

options_te.c: Sálim Ali Centre for Ornithology and Natural History

explanation_en: SACON is India’s dedicated institution for ornithology and natural-history research and training.
explanation_te: SACON ornithology, natural-history research, trainingకు India dedicated institution.

question_en: Which location–institution pairing is correct?
question_te: సరైన location–institution pairing ఏది?

options_en.a: SACON—Kolkata
options_en.b: SACON—New Delhi
options_en.c: SACON—Dehradun
options_en.d: SACON—Anaikatty, Coimbatore

explanation_en: SACON is located at Anaikatty near Coimbatore and maintains an ornithological research and training focus.
explanation_te: SACON Coimbatore సమీపంలోని Anaikattyలో ఉంది; ornithological research, trainingపై focus చేస్తుంది.

question_en: Which description of the National Green Tribunal is correct?
question_te: National Green Tribunalను సరిగా వివరించేది ఏది?

options_en.a: A specialised adjudicatory forum for substantial environmental questions under the enactments listed in Schedule I of the NGT Act
options_en.b: A wildlife-management authority chaired by the Prime Minister
options_en.c: A non-statutory wetland-funding scheme
options_en.d: A forest-survey office under MoEFCC

options_te.a: NGT Act Schedule Iలో listed enactments కింద substantial environmental questionsకు specialised adjudicatory forum
options_te.b: Prime Minister chair చేసే wildlife-management authority

explanation_en: The NGT is a statutory adjudicatory forum created in 2010, not a policy, funding, or field-management institution.
explanation_te: NGT 2010లో సృష్టించిన statutory adjudicatory forum; policy, funding లేదా field-management institution కాదు.

question_en: Assertion (A): NGT jurisdiction is linked to enactments in Schedule I of the NGT Act. Reason (R): CAMPA manages compensatory-afforestation funds collected on forest diversion. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): NGT jurisdiction, NGT Act Schedule I enactmentsతో linked. కారణం (R): Forest diversionపై collected compensatory-afforestation fundsను CAMPA manage చేస్తుంది. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both are true, but CAMPA’s fund-management function does not explain the statutory limits of NGT jurisdiction.
explanation_te: రెండూ నిజం; కానీ CAMPA fund-management function, NGT jurisdiction statutory limitsను వివరించదు.

question_en: What does CAMPA principally manage?
question_te: CAMPA ప్రధానంగా ఏది manage చేస్తుంది?

options_en.a: Zoo-recognition applications
options_en.b: Wildlife-crime intelligence
options_en.c: Compensatory-afforestation funds arising from forest-land diversion
options_en.d: Ramsar nominations

options_te.c: Forest-land diversion నుంచి వచ్చే compensatory-afforestation funds

explanation_en: CAMPA authorities manage earmarked compensatory-afforestation money rather than ordinary general revenue.
explanation_te: CAMPA authorities ordinary general revenue కాకుండా earmarked compensatory-afforestation moneyను manage చేస్తాయి.

question_en: What gives CAMPA its present statutory foundation?
question_te: CAMPAకు present statutory foundation ఇచ్చేది ఏది?

options_en.a: An executive circular under NPCA
options_en.b: The Ramsar Convention
options_en.c: WPA section 38L
options_en.d: Compensatory Afforestation Fund Act, 2016

explanation_en: The 2016 Act placed the earlier ad hoc mechanism on a permanent statutory footing through National and State Funds and authorities.
explanation_te: 2016 Act earlier ad hoc mechanismను National, State Funds, authorities ద్వారా permanent statutory footingపై ఉంచింది.

question_en: A petition alleges only that a wildlife authority violated the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972. Can the NGT assume direct Schedule I jurisdiction solely on that basis?
question_te: Wildlife authority Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972ను violate చేసిందని మాత్రమే petition alleges చేస్తోంది. ఆ basisపై మాత్రమే NGT direct Schedule I jurisdiction తీసుకోగలదా?

options_en.a: Yes, because every environmental statute is in Schedule I.
options_en.b: No; the WPA is not listed, so a genuine overlapping issue under a scheduled enactment is ordinarily required.
options_en.c: Yes, if the species is endangered.
options_en.d: No, because the NGT can never hear a wildlife-related dispute.

options_te.a: అవును; ప్రతి environmental statute Schedule Iలో ఉంది.
options_te.b: కాదు; WPA listed కాదు, కాబట్టి scheduled enactment కింద genuine overlapping issue సాధారణంగా అవసరం.
options_te.d: కాదు; NGT ఎప్పుడూ wildlife-related disputeను వినదు.

explanation_en: WPA violation alone does not create direct Schedule I jurisdiction. A wildlife dispute can still reach the NGT through a real EPA, forest-law, BDA, or other scheduled-enactment issue.
explanation_te: WPA violation ఒక్కటే direct Schedule I jurisdictionను సృష్టించదు. Real EPA, forest-law, BDA లేదా ఇతర scheduled-enactment issue ద్వారా wildlife dispute NGTకు రావచ్చు.

question_en: Which statement correctly describes the relationship between the WPA and NGT Act Schedule I?
question_te: WPA, NGT Act Schedule I మధ్య relationshipను సరిగా వివరించేది ఏది?

options_en.a: The WPA is expressly first in Schedule I.
options_en.b: The WPA is not listed in Schedule I, though overlapping scheduled-law questions may support NGT jurisdiction.
options_en.c: The WPA was repealed by the NGT Act.
options_en.d: Only WPA cases may be filed before the NGT.

options_te.a: WPA Schedule Iలో మొదట expressly listed.
options_te.b: WPA Schedule Iలో listed కాదు; అయితే overlapping scheduled-law questions NGT jurisdictionకు support ఇవ్వవచ్చు.
options_te.d: WPA cases మాత్రమే NGT ముందు file చేయవచ్చు.

explanation_en: The jurisdictional inquiry turns on the scheduled enactment actually implicated, not simply on the environmental importance of the dispute.
explanation_te: Jurisdictional inquiry dispute environmental importanceపై మాత్రమే కాకుండా implicated scheduled enactmentపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.

question_en: Which group consists entirely of non-statutory scientific or research institutions?
question_te: పూర్తిగా non-statutory scientific లేదా research institutions కలిగిన group ఏది?

options_en.a: NTCA, WCCB, CZA
options_en.b: NBWL, NBA, NGT
options_en.c: FSI, NBPGR, SACON
options_en.d: CZA, WII, SBB

explanation_en: FSI, NBPGR, and SACON perform important public scientific functions, but none is constituted as a statutory authority by the environmental Acts discussed here.
explanation_te: FSI, NBPGR, SACON ముఖ్యమైన public scientific functions నిర్వహించినా, ఇక్కడ చర్చించిన environmental Acts ద్వారా statutory authoritiesగా constituted కాలేదు.

question_en: Assertion (A): FSI, NBPGR, and SACON are non-statutory institutions. Reason (R): An institution becomes statutory only because it publishes official national data. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): FSI, NBPGR, SACON non-statutory institutions. కారణం (R): Official national data publish చేసినంత మాత్రాన institution statutory అవుతుంది. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.c: A is false, but R is true.
options_en.d: Both A and R are false.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.

explanation_en: A is true. R is false because statutory character depends on a constituting law, not on prominence, official data production, or scientific importance.
explanation_te: A నిజం. Statutory character constituting lawపై ఆధారపడుతుంది; prominence, official data లేదా scientific importanceపై కాదు కాబట్టి R తప్పు.

question_en: Match the National Wildlife Database snapshot dated 27 November 2023: 1. National Parks; 2. Wildlife Sanctuaries; 3. Conservation Reserves; 4. Community Reserves.
question_te: 27 November 2023 National Wildlife Database snapshotను match చేయండి: 1. National Parks; 2. Wildlife Sanctuaries; 3. Conservation Reserves; 4. Community Reserves.
explanation_en: The dated snapshot totals 1,014 protected areas. These are historical figures, not an undated claim about the present network.
explanation_te: ఈ dated snapshot మొత్తం 1,014 protected areas. ఇవి historical figures; present networkపై undated claim కాదు.

question_en: Which statement accurately reports the protected-area snapshot used in the source?
question_te: Sourceలో ఉపయోగించిన protected-area snapshotను accurately report చేసే statement ఏది?

options_en.a: It is a live dashboard count with no status date.
options_en.b: PIB reported on 3 March 2025 figures carrying a 27 November 2023 status date: 1,014 PAs covering 5.32%.
options_en.c: It proves the same totals remain current indefinitely.
options_en.d: It counts Tiger Reserves as a fifth WPA protected-area category.

options_te.a: ఇది status date లేని live dashboard count.
options_te.b: PIB 3 March 2025న, 27 November 2023 status date కలిగిన figuresను report చేసింది: 1,014 PAs, 5.32% coverage.
options_te.c: అదే totals ఎప్పటికీ current అని ఇది నిరూపిస్తుంది.
options_te.d: Tiger Reservesను fifth WPA protected-area categoryగా count చేస్తుంది.

explanation_en: Publication date and data-status date must be kept distinct. Counts should be refreshed before use as current affairs.
explanation_te: Publication date, data-status dateను వేరుగా ఉంచాలి. Current affairsగా ఉపయోగించే ముందు countsను refresh చేయాలి.

question_en: How should Tiger Reserve, Biosphere Reserve, and Ramsar Site totals be presented in an exam answer?
question_te: Tiger Reserve, Biosphere Reserve, Ramsar Site totalsను exam answerలో ఎలా present చేయాలి?

options_en.a: As permanent constitutional numbers
options_en.b: Without naming any source
options_en.c: With an official source and an explicit status date
options_en.d: By adding all three as WPA protected areas

explanation_en: These totals change as sites are added or statuses change. A dated official snapshot is essential.
explanation_te: Sites add అవడం లేదా status మారడం వల్ల totals మారుతాయి. Dated official snapshot అవసరం.

question_en: Which inference from a dated Ramsar or Tiger Reserve count is invalid?
question_te: Dated Ramsar లేదా Tiger Reserve count నుంచి ఏ inference invalid?

options_en.a: It records the source’s position on the stated date.
options_en.b: A later answer should check for additions or corrections.
options_en.c: Different designation systems should be counted separately.
options_en.d: The number is legally frozen for all future examinations.

options_te.a: Stated dateన source positionను record చేస్తుంది.
options_te.b: Later answer additions లేదా correctionsను check చేయాలి.
options_te.c: Different designation systemsను separately count చేయాలి.
options_te.d: అన్ని future examinationsకు number legally frozen.

explanation_en: A dated count is a snapshot, not a permanent statutory ceiling.
explanation_te: Dated count snapshot మాత్రమే; permanent statutory ceiling కాదు.

question_en: Which statement best relates India’s dated WPA protected-area coverage to the global “30x30” goal?
question_te: India dated WPA protected-area coverageను global “30x30” goalతో సరిగా relate చేసే statement ఏది?

options_en.a: The 5.32% WPA-area snapshot is not the whole Target-3 accounting picture; other qualifying area-based measures, including OECMs, may matter.
options_en.b: India had already notified exactly 30% as National Parks in 2023.
options_en.c: Every OECM automatically becomes a WPA Sanctuary.
options_en.d: Target 3 measures only the number of institutions.

options_te.a: 5.32% WPA-area snapshot మొత్తం Target-3 accounting picture కాదు; OECMs సహా ఇతర qualifying area-based measures కూడా relevant కావచ్చు.
options_te.b: 2023లోనే India exactly 30%ను National Parksగా notify చేసింది.
options_te.c: ప్రతి OECM automatically WPA Sanctuary అవుతుంది.
options_te.d: Target 3 institutions సంఖ్యను మాత్రమే measure చేస్తుంది.

explanation_en: WPA coverage is one component. Target 3 also concerns effective area-based conservation and can include qualifying OECMs without converting them into WPA categories.
explanation_te: WPA coverage ఒక component. Target 3 effective area-based conservationను కూడా చూస్తుంది; qualifying OECMs WPA categoriesగా మారకుండానే contribute చేయవచ్చు.

question_en: Assertion (A): WPA protected-area coverage alone does not exhaust possible Target-3 contributions. Reason (R): India’s biodiversity-policy sequence includes the 1999 Strategy, NBAP 2008, 2014 Addendum, and NBSAP 2024–2030. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): WPA protected-area coverage ఒక్కటే possible Target-3 contributions మొత్తాన్ని cover చేయదు. కారణం (R): India biodiversity-policy sequenceలో 1999 Strategy, NBAP 2008, 2014 Addendum, NBSAP 2024–2030 ఉన్నాయి. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both are true, but the policy chronology does not explain why OECMs and other qualifying measures can contribute to Target 3.
explanation_te: రెండూ నిజం; కానీ policy chronology, OECMs మరియు ఇతర qualifying measures Target 3కు ఎందుకు contribute చేయగలవో వివరించదు.

question_en: Choose the correct chronological sequence of India’s national biodiversity-policy instruments.
question_te: India national biodiversity-policy instrumentsకు సరైన chronological sequence ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: NBAP 2008 → 1999 Strategy → NBSAP 2024–2030 → 2014 Addendum
options_en.b: 2014 Addendum → 1999 Strategy → NBAP 2008 → NBSAP 2024–2030
options_en.c: 1999 Strategy → NBAP 2008 → 2014 Addendum → NBSAP 2024–2030
options_en.d: 1999 Strategy → 2014 Addendum → NBAP 2008 → NBSAP 2024–2030

explanation_en: The sequence moves from the 1999 macro strategy to the Cabinet-approved 2008 plan, its 2014 Aichi-era Addendum, and the KMGBF-aligned 2024–2030 plan.
explanation_te: Sequence 1999 macro strategy నుంచి Cabinet-approved 2008 plan, 2014 Aichi-era Addendum, KMGBF-aligned 2024–2030 planకు వెళుతుంది.

question_en: How are the 1999 biodiversity strategy and NBAP 2008 best distinguished?
question_te: 1999 biodiversity strategy, NBAP 2008ను ఎలా distinguish చేయాలి?

options_en.a: They are the same document under two titles.
options_en.b: NBAP 2008 predates the 1999 Strategy.
options_en.c: The 1999 Strategy was a Ramsar instrument.
options_en.d: The 1999 document was a macro-level strategy; NBAP 2008 was the later Cabinet-approved action plan.

options_te.d: 1999 document macro-level strategy; NBAP 2008 తరువాతి Cabinet-approved action plan.

explanation_en: The later action plan built on the earlier strategic foundation; the dates and document types should not be collapsed.
explanation_te: Later action plan earlier strategic foundationపై నిర్మితమైంది; dates, document typesను కలపకూడదు.

question_en: What did the 2014 Addendum to NBAP 2008 introduce?
question_te: NBAP 2008కు 2014 Addendum ఏమి introduce చేసింది?

options_en.a: Twelve Indian National Biodiversity Targets framed in the Aichi-era strategic context
options_en.b: Twenty-three KMGBF targets copied in 2008
options_en.c: A new Wildlife Protection Act
options_en.d: The first Ramsar Convention

options_te.a: Aichi-era strategic contextలో framed చేసిన 12 Indian National Biodiversity Targets

explanation_en: The Addendum supplemented rather than replaced NBAP 2008 and articulated 12 NBTs.
explanation_te: Addendum NBAP 2008ను replace చేయకుండా supplement చేసి 12 NBTsను articulate చేసింది.

question_en: How did India’s 12 targets in the 2014 Addendum relate to the 20 Aichi Targets?
question_te: 2014 Addendumలోని India 12 targets, 20 Aichi Targetsతో ఎలా relate అయ్యాయి?

options_en.a: India rejected all Aichi Targets.
options_en.b: The 20 Aichi Targets were subsumed within 12 nationally framed targets rather than copied one-for-one.
options_en.c: Each Indian target reproduced exactly two Aichi Targets.
options_en.d: The Addendum used the later KMGBF, not the Aichi framework.

options_te.a: India అన్ని Aichi Targetsను reject చేసింది.
options_te.b: 20 Aichi Targets one-for-one copy కాకుండా 12 nationally framed targetsలో subsume అయ్యాయి.
options_te.c: ప్రతి Indian target exactly రెండు Aichi Targetsను reproduce చేసింది.
options_te.d: Addendum Aichi framework కాకుండా later KMGBFను ఉపయోగించింది.

explanation_en: The mapping was consolidated, not numerically identical.
explanation_te: Mapping consolidated రూపంలో ఉంది; numerically identical కాదు.

question_en: Which statement correctly describes India’s NBSAP 2024–2030?
question_te: India NBSAP 2024–2030ను సరిగా వివరించే statement ఏది?

options_en.a: It contains 12 Aichi-era targets and was released in 2014.
options_en.b: It is a wildlife statute enacted by Parliament.
options_en.c: It was released at CBD COP16 in Cali on 30 October 2024 and sets 23 NBTs aligned with the KMGBF.
options_en.d: It is an undated MoEFCC funding circular.

options_te.a: ఇందులో 12 Aichi-era targets ఉన్నాయి; 2014లో release అయింది.
options_te.b: ఇది Parliament enact చేసిన wildlife statute.
options_te.c: 30 October 2024న Cali CBD COP16లో release అయి KMGBFతో aligned 23 NBTsను set చేసింది.

explanation_en: The plan mirrors the KMGBF’s 23-target structure and uses 2030 and 2050 horizons.
explanation_te: Plan KMGBF 23-target structureను mirror చేసి 2030, 2050 horizonsను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

question_en: Assertion (A): NBSAP 2024–2030 contains 23 NBTs aligned with the KMGBF. Reason (R): India treats KMGBF Target 3 as a collective global goal and allows qualifying OECMs to contribute. Choose the correct code.
question_te: ప్రతిపాదన (A): NBSAP 2024–2030లో KMGBFతో aligned 23 NBTs ఉన్నాయి. కారణం (R): India KMGBF Target 3ను collective global goalగా చూసి qualifying OECMs contributionను అనుమతిస్తుంది. సరైన కోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి.

options_en.a: Both A and R are true, and R explains A.
options_en.b: Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A.
options_en.c: A is true, but R is false.
options_en.d: A is false, but R is true.

options_te.a: A, R రెండూ నిజం; R, Aను వివరిస్తుంది.
options_te.b: A, R రెండూ నిజం; కానీ R, Aను వివరించదు.

explanation_en: Both are true, but India’s interpretation of one target does not explain why the NBSAP contains 23 targets overall.
explanation_te: రెండూ నిజం; కానీ ఒక targetపై India interpretation, NBSAPలో మొత్తం 23 targets ఎందుకు ఉన్నాయో వివరించదు.

question_en: Consider India’s position on KMGBF Target 3: 1. It is treated as a collective global goal. 2. Every Party must notify exactly 30% as WPA land. 3. Qualifying OECMs may contribute. Which statements are correct?
question_te: KMGBF Target 3పై India positionను పరిగణించండి: 1. ఇది collective global goalగా treat అవుతుంది. 2. ప్రతి Party exactly 30%ను WPA landగా notify చేయాలి. 3. Qualifying OECMs contribute చేయవచ్చు. సరైన statements ఏవి?

options_en.a: 1 only
options_en.b: 1 and 3 only
options_en.c: 2 and 3 only
options_en.d: 1, 2 and 3

explanation_en: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Target 3 is not read as an identical requirement that every country notify exactly 30% under India’s WPA.
explanation_te: Statements 1, 3 సరైనవి. ప్రతి country exactly 30%ను India WPA కింద notify చేయాలనే identical requirementగా Target 3ను చదవరు.

question_en: Which statement correctly represents India’s position on KMGBF Target 3 (“30x30”)?
question_te: KMGBF Target 3 (“30x30”)పై India positionను సరిగా చూపే statement ఏది?

options_en.a: Every country must notify exactly 30% of its territory as WPA protected areas.
options_en.b: India treats it as a collective global goal; qualifying OECMs may contribute without becoming WPA protected areas.
options_en.c: Only National Parks can count toward area-based conservation.
options_en.d: OECM recognition automatically transfers land ownership to the State.

options_te.a: ప్రతి country తన territoryలో exactly 30%ను WPA protected areasగా notify చేయాలి.
options_te.b: India దీన్ని collective global goalగా చూస్తుంది; qualifying OECMs WPA protected areasగా మారకుండానే contribute చేయవచ్చు.
